answer: Sybil resistance bonds each identity in escrow and links evidence of coordinated equivocation: when k identities sign conflicting histories, pairwise-correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), not as independent per-signer charges. Detection also triggers asymmetric depreciation; compounded collateral haircuts make a controlled swarm’s total capital loss exponential in its size. A falcon-verified proof traversing the trellis can expose the colluding island without penalizing honest, uncorrelated validators.
